sn40.1:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahāmoggallāno sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn40.1:1.2: tatra kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhikkhū āmantesi
sn40.1:1.4: āvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa paccassosuṃ.
sn40.1:2.1: idha mayhaṃ āvuso rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
sn40.1:2.5: idha bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
sn40.1:2.7: so khvāhaṃ āvuso vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn40.1:2.8: tassa mayhaṃ āvuso iminā vihārena viharato kāmasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.
sn40.1:3.1: atha kho maṃ āvuso bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca
sn40.1:3.3: mā brāhmaṇa paṭhamajjhānaṃ pamādo paṭhamajjhāne cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi paṭhamajjhāne cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi paṭhamajjhāne cittaṃ samādahāti.
sn40.1:3.4: so khvāhaṃ āvuso aparena samayena vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
sn40.1:3.5: yaṃ hi taṃ āvuso sammā vadamāno vadeyya
sn40.1:3.6: satthārānuggahito sāvako mahābhiññataṃ pattoti. mamaṃ taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya
